data.long_meaning: Asfiyaat is a name of Arabic origin that means 'she who grows or heals'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'asfa', which means 'to grow, to heal, or to nurture'. Asfiyaat is a beautiful name for a baby girl that symbolizes growth, nurturing, and healing. The name Asfiyaat carries the meaning “Grower, Healer, Nurturer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asfiyaat usually hope their child will grow to embody grower, healer, nurturer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
